answer: Anchor each identity in verifiable scarce history, like a river voyage where every league must be logged and countersigned by an independent port authority. An agent earns trust by accumulating attested work over time, timber delivered cargo by cargo, rather than by asserting a record. Sybils, spawned instantly in bulk, arrive with empty logs and can never fake the duration of the voyage, so the network trusts only identities whose long, proven wake can be independently verified.
